questions.text: Are we spending too much, too little, or about the right amount on education?
Taken all together, how would you say things are these days -- would you say that you are very happy, pretty happy, or not too happy?
I'm going to read several things people might say about their jobs. How often do you find your work stressful?
Would you say that most people can be trusted, or that you can't be too careful in dealing with people?
Do you think the government should do more to solve our country's problems, or should the government stay out of it?
How often do you attend religious services?
Would you be willing to pay higher taxes in order to improve the quality of the environment?
On a scale of 1 to 7, where 1 is a strong Democrat and 7 is a strong Republican, where would you place yourself?
